summary: erxes insurance_api plugin: a GraphQL insurance CRM vertical (Node/TS, mongoose+Apollo). One actor on the panel — VendorUser (email/password) — whose login opens a session carrying $actor.id plus $session.vendor (the user's Vendor). Vendor-scoped reads (myVendor, vendor contracts) are gated on that session. drop list: health_check (candidate health probe, no persisted domain), region_seed (a hardcoded seeder — recreated via region_create/region_set_countries), vendor/region add-/remove- granular list mutations (consolidated into update_offerings / set_countries so their write effect is verifiable).
